description:
Random Weapon Collection
Download Here

Adds a few weapons and some ships I wanted to make.
Still under construction, but releasing so people can try them out.

If you have a good idea for something I should add, let me know.  I might make it.  Maybe.
Balance feedback is appreciated
Contains:

Spoiler
Egret- Midline capital carrier very similar to the Heron

Onslaught (B)- Onslaught variant with a beam TPC.  Does not spawn in NPC fleets/markets currently.

Conqueror- Midline battleship, fast but very poor rear arcs.  Comes with 2 fighter bays.

Javelin- Midline cruiser with AAF.  Main armament is 4 medium ballistics.

Polaris- Midline battlecarrier with reloading Harpoon launchers.

Viper- Midline frigate with AAF.

Barrage-Capital ship made out of station parts.  Slow, but heavy firepower.

Viking -Missile frigate

Warhawk- Very mobile cruiser, based on the Falcon.

Autopulse Beam- Designed as a shitpost, is just an Autopulse Laser that was turned into a beam weapon.  Does not spawn in NPC fleets/markets currently.
Plasma Beam- Similar to the Autopulse Beam, but based on the Plasma Cannon.  Does not spawn in NPC fleets/markets currently.
Tachyon Accelerator- Projectile variant of Tachyon Lance.  Does not pierce shields.  Will occasionally show up in mercenary fleets.
Light Mjolnir- Single-barrel Mjolnir, fits in medium slots.
Mjolnir Heavy Cannon- Triple-barrel Mjolnir, good luck finding something with the flux to use this well.
Devastation- Large slot HE ballistic weapon.   Will show up in mercenary fleets occasionally.
Heavy Positron Cannon- Hybrid large weapon.  Probably needs more balancing.
Positron Cannon- Medium version of the Heavy Positron Cannon.
Piledriver Heavy Railcannon- Large kinetic ballistic.
Harpoon Missile Battery-Large slot Harpoon launcher.

Can be added mid-playthrough and should function correctly if done.

If you have a good idea for something I should add, let me know.  I might make it.  Maybe.
Balance feedback is appreciated
Known issues:

Spoiler
-Due to Persean League doctrine, the Egret will rarely spawn in faction stores.
-The Onslaught variant is terribly balanced.  This is fine.
-Sounds for the beam weapons are terrible.  Will be fixed in a future release.

Changelog:

Spoiler
0.0.5
Added the Tachyon Accelerator, a large slot energy weapon similar to the Tachyon Lance.  Has no shield-penetrating effect.
Added onhit effect to Tachyon Accelerator.
0.0.6
Updates Onslaught (B) sprite to match updated Onslaught, and properly centers the right builtin weapon slot.
Updates Egret sprite, large mount should no longer be blurry.
0.0.7
Reduced Egret's flux dissipation to 600.
Increased the Mjolnir Heavy Cannon's projectile speed to 900, to match the stock Mjolnir.
Added the Conqueror, a fast midline capital with forward-focused firepower.  Very weak if flanked.
Added the Light Mjolnir, a single-barrel medium slot version of the Mjolnir Cannon.
Updated sprite for Plasma Beam and Autopulse Beam.  They now no longer use the same sprite as the Plasma Cannon/Autopulse Laser.
0.0.8
Changes Plasma Beam sound.
Fixes missing mod_info.json
0.0.9
Updated Mjolnir Heavy Cannon sprite.  Should sit correctly on turret mounts now.
Added the Javelin, a midline cruiser equipped with AAF.
Added the Light Mjolnir to the Persean League's known blueprints.
0.0.10
Added the Polaris, a midline battlecarrier cruiser.
Buffed Conqueror (50->45) and Javelin (25->22) DP.
0.0.11
Reworked Egret sprite and added one additional small energy mount.  OP 260->265.
Added the Heavy Positron Cannon, a hybrid large weapon.
0.0.12
Added the Viper, a midline frigate with AAF.
Added the Barrage, a capital ship built out of station modules.  Slow, but very heavy firepower.
0.0.13
Added the Harpoon Battery, a large slot Harpoon.
Added the Piledriver Heavy Railcannon, a large slot kinetic weapon.  Will appear in enemy fleets.
The Viper should now spawn in NPC fleets.
Fixed the Mjolnir Heavy Cannon sprite (again).
0.0.14
Added the Positron Cannon, a medium slot version of the Heavy Positron Cannon.
Added the Viking, a missile frigate.
Added the Warhawk, a very mobile midline cruiser.  Will appear rarely in mercenary fleets.
Buffed the Piledriver Heavy Railcannon, OP 26->22, damage 400->450, and range 900->1000.
0.0.15
Adds version checker support.
Added the Wildcat, a DEM bomber.
Rebalanced the Warhawk.  Added a large hybrid hardpoint, DP 22->26, +50 dissipation/+500 capacity.  Sprite reworked by Toopok.
0.0.16
Nerfed the Piledriver Heavy Railcannon. It now fires single shots, with worse flux efficiency.  OP 22->25.
Nerfed the Devastation.  Damage 450->400, added recoil.
Nerfed Harpoon Battery.  Ammo 80->48
Buffed Heavy Positron Cannon. OP 30->27
Added the Phase Beam Battery, a triple phase beam in a large slot.  High damage output, bad range and slightly less flux efficient.
Added the Hurricane, a high tech frigate with Terminator drones.
Added the Vulcan, a cross between the Onslaught and Conquest.
Added the Triumphant, a broadside capital ship with heavy armor.
Enabled spawning of a few more ships in shops and enemy fleets.
0.1.1
Now requires Magiclib and Lazylib.
Added the Flash HVM, a very maneuverable short-medium range missile.  Comes in small, medium, and large versions.
Added the Critical Point Targeting hullmod.  It increases weapon damage, and buffs range slightly, but prevents installation of ITU/DTC.
Added the Eagle II, a modified Eagle with a large hardpoint.
Added a secret ship as a bounty.  Thanks to NEON for the sprite.
Fixed hardpoint recoil for Light Mjolnir.
Made the Tachyon Accelerator's projectile much larger for better visibility.
Updated the sprites for the Tachyon Accelerator and Plasma Beam, both are now more visually distinct from the Tachyon Lance and Plasma Cannon.
Updated the Triumphant's sprite-added slightly more plating near the bridge.
Nerfed the Polaris' built-in missile reload slightly.
0.1.2
Added the Hellfire Mortar, a bad idea.  Medium slot Hellbore with bad everything.
Added the Onager Cannon, a medium frag ballistic.
Reworked the Javelin's sprite slightly.
Lowered the base value of several ships and weapons.  Now they should be able to be purchased at reasonable cost.  Ship restoration should also not require 8 figures anymore.
Added the Solace Plasma Bomber.

Credit for things not designed by me:

Spoiler
Dark.Revenant for allowing use of code from SWP
-Used for Tachyon Accelerator onhit script.
tomatopaste, for making the sprite used for the Conqueror
charmingthree, for making the sprites used for the Javelin and Polaris
HELMUT, for making the sprite edited for the Heavy Positron Cannon.
kwbr, for making the sprite used for the Viper.
bigbeans, for making the sprite used for the Viking
kirbo, for making the sprite used for the Warhawk
Toopok, for reworking the Warhawk sprite.
Amazigh, for making the sprite I used to make the Vulcan
-Bashed out of parts taken from the Onquest from his mod "RotcesRats"
Vicegrip, for allowing use of code from Emergent Threats
-used to block incompatible hullmods
N1MH, for allowing use of sprites from Aegis Protectorate
-used to make the Eagle II sprite
NEON, for the sprite of the phase capital & its engine pods
starficz, for allowing use of the vector engine code from KOL
ultra_43084, for the sprite used for the Solace bomber

Compatibile with 0.98.  May not work correctly on earlier versions.

discordPostHtml:
Adds a few ships and weapons I came up with.

If you have a good idea for something I should add, let me know.
Balance feedback is appreciated.
Feel free to ping me.

Contains: ##

Ships ##

Egret- Midline capital carrier very similar to the Heron
Onslaught (B)- Onslaught variant with a beam TPC. Does not spawn in NPC fleets/markets currently.
Conqueror- Midline battleship, fast but very poor rear arcs. Comes with 2 fighter bays.
Javelin- Midline cruiser with AAF. Main armament is 4 medium ballistics.
Polaris- Midline battlecarrier with reloading Harpoon launchers.
Viper- Midline frigate with AAF.
Barrage-Capital ship made out of station parts. Slow, but heavy firepower.
Viking -Missile frigate
Warhawk- Very mobile cruiser, based on the Falcon.
Hurricane- high tech frigate with Terminator drones.
Vulcan- cross between the Onslaught and Conquest.
Triumphant- broadside capital ship with heavy armor.

Weapons ##

Devastation- Large slot HE ballistic weapon. Will show up in mercenary fleets occasionally.
Mjolnir Heavy Cannon- Triple-barrel Mjolnir, good luck finding something with the flux to use this well.
Autopulse Beam- Designed as a shitpost, is just an Autopulse Laser that was turned into a beam weapon. Does not spawn in NPC fleets/markets currently.
Plasma Beam- Similar to the Autopulse Beam, but based on the Plasma Cannon. Does not spawn in NPC fleets/markets currently.
Tachyon Accelerator- Projectile variant of Tachyon Lance. Does not pierce shields.
Light Mjolnir- Single-barrel Mjolnir, fits in medium slots.
Heavy Positron Cannon- Hybrid large weapon. Probably needs more balancing.
Positron Cannon- Hybrid medium weapon.
Piledriver Heavy Railcannon- Large kinetic ballistic.
Harpoon Missile Battery-Large slot Harpoon launcher.
Phase Beam Battery- triple phase beam in a large slot. High damage output, bad range and slightly less flux efficient than the standard Phase Lance.
Flash HVM- Very maneuverable missile with a relatively short lockon range. Great against lighter ships, and comes in small, medium, and large sizes.
Onager Cannon- Fragmentation cannon, good fire rate but ineffective against armor or shields.
Hellfire Mortar- Deals heavy damage if it manages to hit. If.

Wings ##

Wildcat- DEM bomber
Solace- Energy "bomber"

Can be added mid-playthrough and should function correctly if done.

It also adds several new weapons like the Tachyon Accelerator, Mjolnir variants, and various beam cannons. Some items are designed for specific roles or as experimental additions.
